items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: Well like Bunk Johnson I didn't know him too much.

ctx.x: Uh huh. Yes. Well I'll tell you them boys like I said them boys were really wonderful. That all them trumpet players you know they really knew what they were doing. Kid Punch, Buddy Petit, Kid Rene. Well like Bunk Johnson I didn't know him too much. Yeah.
Do you remember Joe Oliver? Did you ever hear him before he went north? No. No I don't. Or Armstrong did you hear him when you were a kid? You'd be pretty young.
